title: The Rice Drink in the Glass Bottle
youtube_title: The Rice Drink in the Glass Bottle | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting kindly is a way of taking care.
summary: At a cottage windowsill of jars, trays, and drying wool, Femi wants to check on a rice drink culturing in a glass bottle before it is ready. With the ferryman nearby, Femi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
